notes: x, y, z, heading are verbatim arguments. loc=fixed: all four are literal numbers. loc=at_existing_mob: the script passes a living mob or corpse position (GetX/GetY/GetZ). loc=computed: a variable or table lookup (coords_expr holds the text).
npc_id null: the npc argument is a table lookup or variable the extractor could not resolve to one number (npc_expr holds the text).

script_refs: ids written inside a zone script that fall in that zone's own npc range (zoneid*1000 to +999), are unplaced in the DB and are not already a direct spawn2 argument. They are REFERENCES, not proven spawns; table-driven spawns (poeartha/encounters/Traps.lua TRAP_SPAWNS) land here.

db: no_spawn_rows = no spawnentry row; spawngroup_without_spawn2 = spawnentry exists but its spawngroup has no spawn2 row; placed = has a spawn2 row; not_in_npc_types = id absent from eqemu_npc_types.

loot lists only AddItem calls (items put on a mob as it spawns or dies). Quest turn-in rewards (QuestReward, SummonCursorItem) are not listed. npc_id null: the script is for a mob or event not tied to one id by the extractor, see script.
timer_overrides: eq.update_spawn_timer and eq.spawn_condition calls with their arguments as written.

The not_in_npc_types ids outside poair come from one template script (Lorisyn_Oakwynd.lua line 6, a Halloween event werewolf, eleven copies); poair 240000 is spawned by poair/encounters/Wind.lua line 173.
